root_cause: The radios component only responds to click events within its own module. When keyboard navigation selects a radio in a different module but same radio group (shared name='reminder'), the original module receives no event, leaving its conditional field visible incorrectly.
repair_strategy: Add a document-level change event listener that detects when any radio in the same name group changes, then updates all conditionals in this module by calling setAttributes on each radio with aria-controls.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users can navigate between all reminder options (including across visual groups) and see dependent fields appear/disappear correctly, satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard), 2.4.3 (Focus Order) and 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value).
functional_risks: Double execution of setAttributes when both click and change events fire for the same interaction (idempotent, low risk).
Document-level listener catches changes from any radio on the page; mitigated by name check.
If modules are dynamically destroyed, document listeners remain (not an issue for static pages).
verification_requirements: Verify keyboard navigation from Text message to opt-out hides mobile field.
Verify keyboard navigation from opt-out to Text message shows mobile field.
Verify mouse click on Text message shows mobile field.
Verify mouse click on opt-out hides mobile field.
Verify Email radio conditional still works.
Verify ARIA attributes (aria-controls, aria-expanded) update correctly on both click and keyboard selection.
